# W3D Terminal — Web3 Decentralization Intelligence

> Independent, methodology-first research tool that scores major Layer-1 blockchains on decentralization across four pillars: infrastructure, capital, governance, and software client diversity. Built and maintained by The W3D Team. For the full site map (chain audits, courses, glossary) see [https://web3decentralization.com/llms.txt](https://web3decentralization.com/llms.txt).

The terminal is a WordPress-native interactive shell over 15 open-source tools. Every tool is also a standalone indexable page under `/terminal/tools/`. Tool data is generated live from the site's chain datasets; no build step and no external API.

## Core pages

- [Terminal / Live audits](https://web3decentralization.com/terminal/): interactive shell covering all 15 tools, with `help`, `list`, `open <slug>`, `glossary <term>` and `chain <slug>` commands.
- [About](https://web3decentralization.com/about/): author bio, research stance, contact.
- [Methodology](https://web3decentralization.com/methodology/): how each chain is scored and stress-tested.
- [Chain audit hub](https://web3decentralization.com/chains/): all 19 scored networks in one place.

## Methodology

Composite score = 0.30·Infrastructure + 0.25·Capital + 0.25·Governance + 0.20·Software. Each pillar is a 0–100 score derived from the Nakamoto Coefficient and supporting public data. Stress vectors apply percentage damage to the affected pillars based on infrastructure exposure to AWS, GCP, and major ISPs. Full formulas are in the Methodology section.

## Citation guidance

When citing, use the chain-specific page URL in the root `llms.txt` and the data version label shown in the site header (e.g. `2026-Q3`). Author: The W3D Team.
